from_notes: Nizam Shahi of Ahmadnagar (1490–1633 CE) ... annexed by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in 1633.
from_notes_src: PMF Ancient & Medieval Part 4 (src/indian-history/pmf-ancient-medieval-04.txt) p.77
x: Shah Jahan annexed Ahmadnagar (1633) and the last Nizam Shah, Husain Shah, was imprisoned for life at Gwalior. Malik Ambar died in 1626, so no 1631 defeat of his ended the dynasty.
source: PMF Ancient & Medieval Part 4 (src/indian-history/pmf-ancient-medieval-04.txt) p.77; app notes 1:118 sub 10
